User question: Which has a later launch year, the 380th Air Expeditionary Wing or Air Botswana?

Query Generator's natural language explanation of its own query:
The query matches the two Operator nodes by name, ensures each has a numeric launch_year, compares the years, and returns the operator with the later launch year along with that year.

Executed Cypher query:
MATCH (o1:Operator), (o2:Operator)
WHERE o1.name CONTAINS "380th Air Expeditionary Wing"
  AND o2.name CONTAINS "Air Botswana"
  AND toInteger(o1.launch_year) IS NOT NULL
  AND toInteger(o2.launch_year) IS NOT NULL
RETURN CASE
         WHEN toInteger(o1.launch_year) > toInteger(o2.launch_year) THEN o1.name
         ELSE o2.name
       END AS laterOperator,
       CASE
         WHEN toInteger(o1.launch_year) > toInteger(o2.launch_year) THEN toInteger(o1.launch_year)
         ELSE toInteger(o2.launch_year)
       END AS launchYear
